objective: Learn informative representations of paired RNA expression and chromatin accessibility; assess paired cross-modal retrieval as a measurable proxy for relationships, without claiming it exhausts biological utility.
data: 10x PBMC Multiome; aligned cell barcode pairs, no genuine cell-type labels.
task: paired retrieval and exploratory representation learning
selection: Mean of RNA-to-ATAC and ATAC-to-RNA Recall@5 on the same 1097-cell validation split only; held-out test reserved for winner after selection. Random ranking Recall@5 is 5/1097.
limitations: Matching same cell may treat biologically similar cells as false negatives; retrieval does not establish biological validity.
